notes.title: The Signal Is Back
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159869/881ba1ece9dcc53768fa99ee968d8258d68c3a63.png[/img]
The Last Transmission is a first-person psychological horror game.
No combat. No escape.
Just a storm. A signal.
And something listening back.

You are the operator of Station 23.
Track the weather. Log the voices.
Follow the static to whatever’s waiting.

Some of you have heard it before.
After the crash. In the warehouse.
When the lights cut out and the air got too still.

It’s quieter now.
But its silence is deeper.
And its absence feels closer.

Find [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3684440/The_Last_Transmission/]The Last Transmission[/url] on Steam.

notes.title: Brief Demo & Full Release Update
notes.notes:
The development of the game is steadily progressing, and the end of the development is coming closer every day. 
[h1]So what is left?[/h1]
[h2]Finishing The Game[/h2]
Basically: Finalizing the last chapters of the game and fine tuning all chapters (details, bug fixes, atmosphere etc...) I will probably be able to do this by the end of September / start of October. Fingers crossed.

[h2]Playtests[/h2]
After this, the major playtests of the game will start. During this phase the focus will be on bug fixing and further improving the experience. In the best case, the playtests will be wrapped up by the start of November.

[h2]The Finishing Touch[/h2]
After the playtests I will be able to announce a date for the game release. The game should be ready towards the end of the year. Meaning you should be able to play the full game in November/December. If there are major issues or something of the sort, this might change, of course. 

[h1]Demo[/h1]
I will take down the demo at the end of August so check it out if you want to try it for yourself! 
A heads up for everyone who played the demo: The save game from your demo might not be compatible with the full game. This is due to an increased amount of information that is saved in the new save files. This probably makes the old ones incompatible.

[h1]Trailer release[/h1]
I will try to create one or two release trailer for the full game by the end of September. So, make sure to watch out for that on YouTube or here on Steam.
